hypothesis: Combining independent rotary elementwise work with attention remainder work may explain the residuals better than either previous model alone. For these short sequences, full vector-block attention work may be less important than these two costs.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.inner_dim * (hidden_states.shape[1] + (hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]))
pcvs.name: projection_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures projection and normalization costs across query and context tokens.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0
pcvs.name: rotary_elements
pcvs.rationale: Restores an independent linear cost for rotary operations, which the previous candidate omitted.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * ((hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) % 16)
pcvs.name: attention_tail_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures scalar attention remainder work across all query rows, including short cross-attention contexts.

pcvs.name: uses_rotary
pcvs.rationale: Separates fixed rotary dispatch and allocation overhead from its elementwise cost.
